subject: HANDOFF: Gen3 transition observability causal attribution
body: Performance R&D completed against unchanged main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. This work deliberately stayed outside state-rd CAS authority and display-rd compositor ownership. Confirmed source finding: TransitionLab already captures strong timing primitives (Samsung/public hinge ingress, FrameTimeline expected presentation, SurfaceControl transaction commit/latch/present fence) and DisplayMirrorHost separately records exact Fold7PresentationLease identity (serviceEpoch, closeCycleId, contentLeaseId, hostEpoch, attemptSequence, renderPath). The dominant observability defect is that those two streams have no immutable join key: SurfaceTransactionProbe.Token carries only transactionSequence/vsyncId, while presentation-stage events carry attempt identity but not the transaction sequence or actual present-fence timestamp. Under host remap, retry, reversal, or crossed callbacks, temporal proximity is not a safe attribution rule. A 7/7 isolated adversarial model passes when transaction timing carries the exact presentation correlation identity and terminal evidence is explicitly classified as ACTUAL_PRESENT_FENCE, FRAME_COMMIT_ONLY, EXPECTED_PRESENT_ONLY, or NO_PRESENTATION_EVIDENCE. Recommended Gen3 shape: preserve TransitionLab; add immutable presentation correlation to SurfaceTransactionProbe.Token/TransactionTimingRecord; serialize it with transactionSequence; retain actual stats.presentFence.signalTime on the same attempt; emit sparse cycle/readiness/visual-demand lifecycle events needed for stage decomposition; never treat frame-commit or expected-presentation timestamps as proof of physical presentation. No GitHub production writes were performed. Primary should independently verify against current main before integration and run physical Fold7 overhead/latency validation after implementation.
